column1: # ci-pkg-times.tsv: seconds per package, the median "ok" time over the queue batches named below (packages none of
# them ran keep their earlier value). ci_shard.sh balances shards on it. <pkg> and its <pkg>#<label> entries are the
# split rows of a package in ci-splits.tsv: engine/rules 178/87/83/61 (409 s, four groups as of 11-27), testkit/
# conformance 94/65 (159 s), dirac/kgen 48/43 (91 s), bots/azmcts 60/20 (80 s), engine/effects 40/25 (65 s).
# Genuine per-group medians: the four-way engine/rules split's provisional flat 110/110/110/109 and the pre-split
# totals the other split entries were seeded with are replaced by measured per-entry times. The same refresh realigns
# the unsplit packages, whose weights had drifted: the balancer had equalized sums of stale weights (312 s nominal)
# while the measured work per shard spread 315-412 s and the shard walls 106-236 s.
# medians). Two more of the five most recent green batches (45994115325, 45995133842) had expired or partial logs, so
# the refresh uses the four whose logs are complete; packages none of them printed keep their earlier value.
# split-entry attribution and the Golden chain heads exclusion are the script's).
